Implement WriteScenarioTestsStage in a new file internal/next/specloop/stages/write_scenario_tests.go. Follow the WriteContractsStage pattern. Config struct: WriteScenarioTestsStageConfig with SpecPath, EvidenceDir, Store, WorkDir fields. Stage struct holds: writer contract.ScenarioTestWriter, cfg, budget *specloop.Budget, eventLog *runstore.EventLog. Constructor: NewWriteScenarioTestsStage. Name() returns 'write_scenario_tests'. The Run method implements: (1) idempotency check on rs.ScenarioTestsWritten, (2) parse scenarios from spec file using contract.ParseScenarios, (3) no-op if no scenarios, (4) collect implementation files from rs.Tasks where Status=='done' (deduplicated union of FilesChanged), (5) load existing manifest from EvidenceDir/scenario-test-manifest.json for partial recovery, (6) iterate scenarios one at a time: check budget before each, skip if manifest shows file exists and compiles (via 'go test -c -o /dev/null ./<pkg>'), call writer.WriteScenarioTest, verify compilation, up to 2 self-repair retries with compile errors, update manifest incrementally, emit scenario_tests_written event per success, (7) on any scenario failing all retries return Blocked with scenario_tests_blocked event, (8) on full success set rs.ScenarioTestsWritten=true, emit scenario_tests_complete event. Compilation check uses exec.Command 'go test -c -o /dev/null ./<package-path>' where package-path is derived from the test file path relative to WorkDir.

Implement FailureHistory helper functions in internal/next/specloop/failure_history.go (exported for testing). Functions: (1) ExtractTestFailureKeys(failures []string) []string — extracts test function names from '--- FAIL: TestFunctionName' patterns in failure strings, (2) ExtractContractFailureKeys(failures []string) []string — extracts 'contract:<scenario-name>' keys by splitting on ' — ' and taking the first segment from failures starting with 'contract:', (3) UpdateFailureHistory(history map[string]int, currentKeys []string) — increments count for keys present, resets to zero for keys not present (then deletes zero entries), (4) AnnotateWithPersistentHints(failures []string, history map[string]int, threshold int) []string — for each failure whose key has count >= threshold, appends a 'persistent-failure: <key> has failed N consecutive cycles — may indicate a bad test specification rather than an implementation bug' hint.

Integrate FailureHistory into the specloop replan path in internal/next/specloop/specloop.go. After a ReplanFrom action is received (where replanContext is set, around line 129-131), call the FailureHistory helpers: (1) extract failure keys from replanContext.Failures using both ExtractTestFailureKeys and ExtractContractFailureKeys, (2) merge the key sets, (3) call UpdateFailureHistory(rs.FailureHistory, mergedKeys) — initialize rs.FailureHistory to empty map if nil first, (4) call AnnotateWithPersistentHints on the failures with threshold 2, (5) store the annotated failures into rs.ReplanContext. Create the LLM adapter for ScenarioTestWriter in internal/next/contract/llm_scenario_test_writer.go. Define LLMScenarioTestWriter struct holding an llmadapter.Adapter (or provider.Provider) and the content of docs/scenario-tests.md (wired at construction time as part of system prompt, not per-call).
